leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a dashboard component with a responsive grid layout using Angular Material components
Initialize and bind real-time data streams to dashboard widgets using Angular services
Configure interactive controls that manipulate dashboard data display parameters
Implement data visualization components that render live metrics with automatic updates
Integrate multiple data sources and update dashboard elements simultaneously
Apply reactive programming patterns to handle asynchronous data flow in the dashboard
Control dashboard state and user interactions through Angular event binding
